<document id="account-verification-failed">
Ifˆweˆcouldn'tˆverifyˆyourˆidentityˆIfˆweˆcouldn'tˆverifyˆyourˆidentity,ˆtheˆappˆtellsˆyouˆwhatˆwentˆwrongˆandˆwhetherˆyouˆcanˆtryˆagain.ˆ##ˆCommonˆreasonsˆ-ˆTheˆphotoˆofˆyourˆIDˆwasˆblurry,ˆcroppedˆorˆhadˆglareˆ-ˆTheˆnameˆorˆdateˆofˆbirthˆdidn'tˆmatchˆyourˆIDˆ-ˆTheˆIDˆhadˆexpiredˆ-ˆTheˆselfieˆdidn'tˆmatchˆtheˆIDˆphotoˆ##ˆTryingˆagainˆYouˆcanˆtryˆupˆtoˆ3ˆtimes.ˆAfterˆthat,ˆtheˆapplicationˆisˆclosedˆandˆyouˆcanˆapplyˆagainˆafterˆ30ˆdays.ˆ##ˆCanˆsupportˆhelp?ˆSupportˆcanˆexplainˆtheˆsteps,ˆbutˆcan'tˆapproveˆanˆapplication,ˆoverrideˆaˆdecision,ˆorˆtellˆyouˆwhyˆaˆdecisionˆwasˆmadeˆbeyondˆwhatˆtheˆappˆshows.ˆVerificationˆdecisionsˆareˆmadeˆbyˆourˆVerificationˆteam.ˆ##ˆTipsˆUseˆyourˆID'sˆexactˆlegalˆname,ˆphotographˆitˆonˆaˆdarkˆbackgroundˆinˆdaylight,ˆandˆtakeˆtheˆselfieˆfacingˆaˆwindow.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="account-documents">
DocumentsˆforˆidentityˆverificationˆToˆverifyˆyourˆidentity,ˆweˆneedˆaˆphotoˆIDˆandˆaˆselfie,ˆplusˆaˆfewˆdetails.ˆ##ˆPhotoˆIDsˆweˆacceptˆ-ˆUSˆdriver'sˆlicenseˆorˆstateˆIDˆcardˆ-ˆUSˆpassportˆorˆpassportˆcardˆ-ˆPermanentˆresidentˆcardˆ-ˆForeignˆpassport,ˆtogetherˆwithˆanˆITINˆTheˆIDˆmustˆbeˆunexpired,ˆandˆallˆfourˆcornersˆmustˆbeˆvisibleˆinˆtheˆphoto.ˆ##ˆSelfieˆTheˆappˆasksˆyouˆtoˆtakeˆaˆshortˆselfieˆvideoˆtoˆmatchˆyourˆfaceˆtoˆtheˆID.ˆRemoveˆglassesˆandˆhats,ˆandˆuseˆgoodˆlight.ˆ##ˆDetailsˆYourˆlegalˆname,ˆdateˆofˆbirth,ˆresidentialˆaddressˆandˆSocialˆSecurityˆnumberˆorˆITIN.ˆYourˆnameˆmustˆmatchˆyourˆID.ˆ##ˆProofˆofˆaddressˆIfˆweˆcan'tˆconfirmˆyourˆaddressˆautomatically,ˆwe'llˆaskˆforˆaˆdocumentˆdatedˆwithinˆtheˆlastˆ90ˆdays,ˆsuchˆasˆaˆutilityˆbill,ˆleaseˆorˆbankˆstatement.ˆ##ˆWhatˆweˆdon'tˆacceptˆExpiredˆIDs,ˆphotocopies,ˆstudentˆIDs,ˆorˆscreenshotsˆofˆanˆID.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="security-two-step">
Two-stepˆverificationˆTwo-stepˆverificationˆisˆalwaysˆonˆforˆTallowbrookˆaccounts.ˆWhenˆyouˆsignˆinˆonˆaˆnewˆdevice,ˆorˆdoˆsomethingˆsensitive,ˆweˆaskˆforˆyourˆpasswordˆandˆaˆsecondˆstep.ˆ##ˆTheˆsecondˆstepˆ-ˆAˆpushˆapprovalˆonˆaˆdeviceˆyou'veˆalreadyˆsignedˆinˆon,ˆorˆ-ˆAˆone-timeˆcodeˆsentˆbyˆtext,ˆvalidˆforˆ10ˆminutesˆ##ˆWhenˆweˆaskˆ-ˆSigningˆinˆonˆaˆnewˆdeviceˆ-ˆChangingˆyourˆpassword,ˆemailˆorˆphoneˆnumberˆ-ˆAddingˆaˆnewˆexternalˆaccountˆorˆwireˆrecipientˆ-ˆViewingˆyourˆfullˆvirtualˆcardˆnumberˆ##ˆKeepˆcodesˆtoˆyourselfˆAˆone-timeˆcodeˆisˆonlyˆforˆyouˆtoˆtypeˆintoˆtheˆTallowbrookˆapp.ˆNobodyˆfromˆTallowbrookˆwillˆaskˆyouˆtoˆreadˆitˆout.ˆIfˆsomeoneˆasks,ˆit'sˆaˆscam.ˆ##ˆChangedˆyourˆphoneˆnumber?ˆUpdateˆitˆinˆtheˆappˆwhileˆyouˆstillˆhaveˆtheˆoldˆnumber.ˆIfˆyou'veˆlostˆaccessˆtoˆyourˆoldˆnumber,ˆmessageˆsupport.ˆWe'llˆpassˆitˆtoˆtheˆteamˆthatˆverifiesˆidentity,ˆwhichˆcanˆtakeˆlonger.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
</documents>

Customer question: How long does identity verification take?
